title: Chain kheenchi, RPF ko coach kaise pata?
voice: ElevenLabs Bunty – Punchy, Crisp and Reel King (website, Eleven v4)
lines: [curious] Train beech me ruki... kisi ne CHAIN kheenchi!
RPF seedha usi coach pe. Kaise?
Chain valve kholti hai, brake ki hawa nikalti hai.
Hawa ki awaaz... usi coach se!
Bina wajah? Ek saal tak JAIL!
Aise aur railway raaz... follow karo!
caption:
Train beech raste ruk gayi... kisi ne alarm chain kheench di. Aur staff seedha usi coach pe pahunch gaya. Usko kaise pata? 🚆🔍

Kaise hota hai:
• Air-brake wali trains me chain ek valve se brake pipe se judi hoti hai. Chain kheenchte hi valve khulta hai aur brake pipe ki hawa bahar nikalne lagti hai.
• Pressure girta hai, loco pilot ko gauge pe dikhta hai aur train ruk jaati hai. Driver horn baja ke guard aur security ko alert karta hai.
• Jis coach me chain kheenchi gayi, wahin se hawa nikalne ki 'ssss' awaaz aati hai. Isi se coach mil jaata hai, aur mechanism reset karke hi train aage badhti hai.

Bina wajah chain kheenchna Railways Act ki Section 141 me jurm hai: 1 saal tak jail, ₹1,000 tak fine, ya dono.

Sirf Prayagraj division me January se April 2026 tak 1,171 log chain pulling me giraftaar hue (ETV Bharat).

Chain sirf asli emergency me, jaise aag ya medical emergency.

Tumhari train kabhi chain pulling se ruki hai? Comment karo 👇
